page.overview:
Who is Benedict Arnold?

Benedict Arnold was a military commander in the Revolutionary War who switched sides from the Americans to the British. In the United States his name is still synonymous with traitor.

Homer is trying to think of names to use when Fat Tony, Louie and Legs abduct him thinking he is actually Krusty except each name is also in trouble with the Springfield Mafia. One bane is Benedict Arnold which Legs asked Homer, "The same Benedict Arnold who plotted plotted to surrender West Point to the hated British?"

Homer sings a tribute to Upstate New York with an outro line, "Benedict Arnold fought here, baby." referencing the Battle of Ticonderoga (previous referenced in "Whacking Day").

Benedict Arnold was a member of Devil Flanders's hand-picked Jury of the Damned, along with Blackbeard, Lizzie Borden, Richard Nixon, John Wilkes Booth, John Dillinger, and the starting lineup of the 1976 Philadelphia Flyers.
